venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Wednesday 3/4.** Steady night. Solid book but weather deterred walk-ins more than expected. Down a bartender; Josh came in to finish inventory and support; ran out of one well most of the night; a couple of moments with a full bar and large parties seated in quick succession; shoutout to Jada and Elliott on the bar top. A guest at bar 2 made creepy remarks to the team and guests but left without fuss. Kitchen: steady; Tyler pushed food and got multiple courses off on larger tables. Guest count 81 (no way to separate walk-ins from reservations). MOD: Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Wednesday 3/4.** Welcome Toast: first night on the new POS; easygoing with less fuss than anticipated; thanks to Willie, Courtney and the Toast team. Few large parties, many first dates; a couple interested in eaux-de-vie ordered Reisetbauer products. Comps $50.30 (~1.57%). Top sellers metric not found in Toast. Door: warmer, chill evening, 4 top from Arkansas celebrating a birthday, 8pm wave of twos, 4 solos together, bar and front tables full until 11:30; Claudio (in a few Smosh episodes) returned. No no-shows. Toast closeout concerns: Z report doesn't show guest count or check average, and many charges fall under 'No Category'; beverage sales were approximated as total net minus food and retail (guest count and check average therefore unavailable).
